name: _Exit
description: The _Exit function terminates the calling process immediately, closing all open file descriptors and ensuring child processes are inherited by the init process. It sends a SIGCHLD signal to the parent and returns the specified status to the parent via wait calls, without performing cleanup like flushing stdio streams.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The exit status of the process, which is returned to the parent process and can be collected using wait functions.

bugs: The _exit() function's behavior has changed since glibc 2.3, where it now terminates all threads in the process using exit_group(2), whereas historically it only terminated the calling thread.
